row: 綠島位於臺東外海約33公里，是由安山岩與火山碎屑構成的火山島，1949年以前多稱為「火燒島」。島上有1938年建成的綠島燈塔、白色恐怖綠島紀念園區、朝日溫泉，以及石朗、柴口、大白沙等珊瑚礁潛點。

airspace.zh: 未查到此處專屬的公告內容；實際飛行前請用民航局「Drone Map」App 查詢並依規定申請。
airspace.en: No site-specific notice was found for this area; before any real flight, check the CAA "Drone Map" app and apply as required.

lighthouse.note: built 1938 after the President Hoover ran aground

visitor.note: exhibits on the island's formation and plants

chaikou.note: snorkel area; the name comes from a wooden stockade

memorial.zh: 白色恐怖綠島紀念園區
memorial.en: Green Island White Terror Memorial Park
memorial.note: former prison compounds on the north-east corner, about 32 ha

guanyin.note: cave with a stalagmite revered as Guanyin

loumen.note: coral rock pierced by a round hole

youzihu.note: cove in an eroded explosion crater

haishenping.note: bay in the remains of a crater, fringing reef

zhaori.note: seawater hot spring facing the sunrise

ziping.note: lagoon inside a coral reef at the southern tip

dabaisha.note: beach of shell and coral beachrock

guoshan.note: old path across the island, paved again with stone

wuyouku.note: tidal pool north of the lighthouse

title.zh-Hant: 火燒島、燈塔與綠洲山莊
title.en: Bonfire Island, a Lighthouse and Oasis Villa

tagline.zh-Hant: 從船難與監獄，到人權紀念園區
tagline.en: From shipwrecks and prisons to a human-rights memorial

zh: 臺東外海的這座火山島，
1949年以前多半叫做「火燒島」。
en: Before 1949 this volcanic island off Taitung
was usually called Bonfire Island.

zh: 1949年8月1日，在臺東縣長黃式鴻的建議下，
島名改為「綠島」。
en: On 1 August 1949, at the urging of Taitung magistrate Huang Shih-hung,
it was renamed Green Island.

zh: 島上最早的住民是阿美族。
1845年，英國軍艦記錄島上約有150位來自廈門一帶的漢人。
en: The Amis were the first inhabitants.
In 1845 a British warship found about 150 settlers from the Amoy region.

zh: 柴口原名「柵口」：
早期漢人與原住民曾在這裡以木牆對峙。
en: Chaikou was first called Zhakou, the stockade mouth:
early Han settlers and islanders once faced each other here behind wooden walls.

zh: 1937年12月11日，郵輪「胡佛總統號」
在颱風中觸礁擱淺。
en: On 11 December 1937 the liner President Hoover
ran onto a reef in a typhoon.

zh: 島民划舢舨出海救援；
船上503位旅客與330位船員全數生還。
en: Islanders rowed out in sampans to help;
all 503 passengers and 330 crew survived.

zh: 美國紅十字會的捐款，促成了這座燈塔；
1938年由島民建成，高33.3公尺。
en: Donations through the American Red Cross paid for this lighthouse;
islanders built it in 1938, 33.3 metres tall.

zh: 相傳清嘉慶年間，遇難的漁民看見東方有火光，
循著火光返航，後來找到這座觀音洞。
en: Legend says that in the Jiaqing years shipwrecked fishermen followed a light in the east
home to safety, and later found this cave.

zh: 戒嚴時期，綠島成為關押政治犯的地方，
從1940年代末延續到1980年代末。
en: Under martial law Green Island held political prisoners,
from the late 1940s to the late 1980s.

zh: 園區歷經「火燒島浮浪者收容所」、「新生訓導處」
與「綠洲山莊」等不同時期的監獄。
en: The grounds went through several prisons in turn:
a vagrant camp, the New Life Correction Centre and Oasis Villa.

zh: 今天的白色恐怖綠島紀念園區，
位在島的東北角，面積約32公頃。
en: Today it is the Green Island White Terror Memorial Park,
about 32 hectares on the north-east corner of the island.

zh: 不遠處的綠島監獄是高度管理的隔離監獄，
至今仍在使用。
en: Nearby, Green Island Prison is a high-security prison
that is still in use.

zh: 今天，島上有機場與南寮漁港，
飛機與渡輪往返臺東。
en: Today an airport and Nanliao Harbour
link the island to Taitung by air and ferry.

zh: 船難、燈塔與監獄，
都是這座小島走過的歷史。
en: Shipwrecks, a lighthouse and prisons:
all are part of this small island's past.

title.zh-Hant: 潛點、古道與海邊的觀音
title.en: Dive Sites, an Old Trail and a Seaside Guanyin

tagline.zh-Hant: 島民怎麼在火山與珊瑚礁之間生活
tagline.en: How islanders live between volcanic rock and coral

zh: 南寮漁港，旅客上岸的地方，
商家多半聚在南寮村。
en: Nanliao Harbour is where visitors land;
most shops are in Nanliao village.

zh: 石朗、柴口與大白沙，
並列為綠島三大潛水區。
en: Shilang, Chaikou and Dabaisha
are the island's three main dive areas.

zh: 石朗離南寮村很近，
浮潛上岸後，走一小段路就能用餐。
en: Shilang is close to Nanliao village:
after snorkelling it is a short walk to a meal.

zh: 這片海底設有海底郵筒，
潛水員帶著特製明信片，潛下去投遞。
en: An undersea postbox stands on the bottom here;
divers take special postcards down to post them.

zh: 遊客中心展示綠島地形的形成、
朝日溫泉的原理與島上的保育植物。
en: The visitor centre explains how the island formed,
how Zhaori Hot Spring works and which plants are protected.

zh: 環島公路通車以前，
島民走山間的古道往來。
en: Before the ring road opened,
islanders travelled on old paths over the hills.

zh: 其中一條整修成石板鋪面的「過山古道」，
沿途能看到樹杞、野牡丹與桃金孃。
en: One became the stone-paved Guoshan Old Trail,
lined with ardisia, melastoma and rose myrtle.

zh: 觀音洞裡有一座石筍，
形似觀世音菩薩。
en: Inside Guanyin Cave stands a stalagmite
shaped like the bodhisattva Guanyin.

zh: 石像面朝東方盤坐，
這裡參拜的方式也因此特別。
en: The stone figure sits facing east,
so people pay their respects here in their own way.

zh: 柚子湖的「湖」，其實是閩南語「澳」的轉音，
指的是海灣，不是湖泊。
en: The "lake" in Youzihu is a twist of the Minnan word for cove:
it is a bay, not a lake.

zh: 東岸的柚子湖與楠仔湖只隔一個岬角，
過去各自形成聚落。
en: On the east coast Youzihu and Nanzaihu lie a headland apart;
each once had its own hamlet.

zh: 從被稱為「小長城」的步道登上觀海亭，
整個海參坪一覽無遺。
en: A path called the Little Great Wall climbs to a sea-view pavilion
that looks over all of Haishenping.

zh: 島的東南角，朝日溫泉面向太平洋，
日治時期稱為「旭溫泉」。
en: On the south-east corner Zhaori Hot Spring faces the Pacific;
under Japanese rule it was called the Rising Sun Spring.

zh: 潛水、溫泉與古道，
讓這座小島成為海上的旅行地。
en: Dives, a hot spring and old trails
have made the small island a place to travel to.

tagline.zh-Hant: 梅花鹿、狐蝠與巨大的珊瑚
tagline.en: Sika deer, flying foxes and giant corals

zh: 黑潮從綠島西岸往北流過，
海水溫暖清澈。
en: The Kuroshio flows north past the west coast;
the water is warm and clear.

zh: 石朗附近的潮流比大白沙穩定，
周邊有多樣的環狀珊瑚礁，人稱海底公園。
en: Near Shilang the current is steadier than at Dabaisha;
ring-shaped reefs all around have earned it the name undersea park.

zh: 石朗外海約150公尺，有一叢「大香菇」珊瑚，
高約12公尺，寬約31公尺。
en: About 150 metres off Shilang grows the Big Mushroom coral,
some 12 metres high and 31 metres wide.

zh: 南寮漁港以南，珊瑚礁海岸緩緩傾入海中；
常見柳穗珊瑚、傘珊瑚與靈芝珊瑚。
en: South of Nanliao the reef slopes gently into the sea;
whip, umbrella and lingzhi corals are common.

zh: 礁上還有桶狀海綿、大旋鰓蟲，
以及河豚、神仙魚與蝦蟹。
en: The reef also holds barrel sponges and Christmas-tree worms,
pufferfish, angelfish, shrimps and crabs.

zh: 島的最南端，紫坪是一處珊瑚礁圍成的潮池，
也是綠島著名的潟湖。
en: At the southern tip, Ziping is a tide pool ringed by coral reef,
the island's best-known lagoon.

zh: 它和臺灣西部常見的沙洲潟湖不同，
是由珊瑚礁構成的堡礁潟湖。
en: Unlike the sandbar lagoons of western Taiwan,
it is a lagoon behind a barrier of coral.

zh: 燈塔北邊的烏油窟，被環狀礁石擋住海浪，
形成一個平靜的小潟湖。
en: North of the lighthouse, a ring of rock holds back the waves at Wuyouku
and leaves a small, calm lagoon.

zh: 島上的山林裡，
有臺灣梅花鹿與山羌。
en: In the island's hill forest live
Formosan sika deer and Reeves's muntjacs.

zh: 夜裡還有琉球狐蝠活動，
島上也有留鳥與過境的候鳥。
en: Ryukyu flying foxes come out at night,
and resident and migrating birds share the island.

zh: 過山古道兩旁，有蘭嶼土沈香、樹杞
等綠島常見的植物。
en: Along the Guoshan Old Trail grow Lanyu excoecaria, ardisia
and other plants typical of Green Island.

zh: 海參坪的彎月形裙礁，
像一道天然的防波堤。
en: At Haishenping a crescent of fringing reef
works like a natural breakwater.

zh: 灣裡海水湛藍清澈，
海下的珊瑚礁生態豐富，是著名的潛點。
en: The water in the bay is clear and blue;
the reef below is rich, a well-known dive site.

zh: 溫暖的黑潮，
養活了這座小島周圍的珊瑚世界。
en: The warm Kuroshio
feeds the coral world around this small island.

tagline.zh-Hant: 爆裂口、海蝕岩與海底溫泉
tagline.en: Explosion craters, sea-carved rock and a seawater hot spring

zh: 綠島在臺灣東部外海約33公里，
是臺灣第七大的島嶼。
en: Green Island lies about 33 km off Taiwan's east coast,
the seventh-largest island of Taiwan.

zh: 滿潮時面積約15.1平方公里，
退潮時約17.3平方公里。
en: At high tide it covers about 15.1 square kilometres,
at low tide about 17.3.

zh: 它是一座火山島，由安山岩、
拉斑玄武岩與火山碎屑構成。
en: It is a volcanic island of andesite,
tholeiitic basalt and volcanic fragments.

zh: 火山在上新世到更新世之間噴發，
屬於呂宋火山島弧的一部分。
en: The volcano erupted between the Pliocene and the Pleistocene;
it is part of the Luzon Volcanic Arc.

zh: 火山集塊岩經過長時間風化與侵蝕，
海岸多半成了崎嶇的珊瑚礁岩岸。
en: Long weathering of the volcanic agglomerate
has left a rugged coast, mostly of coral rock.

zh: 大白沙的沙灘由貝殼與珊瑚碎片岩化而成，叫做「灘岩」。
en: The beach at Dabaisha is shell and coral fragments turned to stone: beachrock.

zh: 朝日溫泉是火山活動加熱的海水，
湧出處就在珊瑚礁旁。
en: Zhaori Hot Spring is seawater heated by volcanic activity,
rising right beside the coral reef.

zh: 泉溫約攝氏53度，酸鹼值7.5，
屬於硫酸鹽氯化物泉，帶著海水的鹹味。
en: The water reaches about 53 °C at pH 7.5,
a sulphate-chloride spring that tastes of the sea.

zh: 東岸海邊立著哈巴狗岩，
周圍是崎嶇的礁岩海岸。
en: Pekingese Dog Rock stands on the east shore,
amid a rugged coast of reef rock.

zh: 海參坪是受侵蝕殘留的火山口；
海岬、海階崖與海蝕柱都在這一帶。
en: Haishenping is what remains of an eroded crater;
headlands, terrace cliffs and sea stacks crowd around it.

zh: 柚子湖也是一個爆裂火山口，
被海浪侵蝕後留下灣澳。
en: Youzihu, too, is an explosion crater
worn by the waves into a cove.

zh: 樓門岩是一串珊瑚礁岩塊中最高大的一塊，
中間被海流貫穿成圓洞。
en: Loumen Rock is the largest of a string of coral blocks;
the current has bored a round hole through it.

zh: 遠遠看去，就像一座海上的拱門。
en: From a distance it looks like a gateway in the sea.

zh: 火山、珊瑚與海浪，
一起塑造了綠島的海岸。
en: Volcano, coral and waves
have shaped Green Island's shore together.
